intro: Brassica oleracea, commonly known as cabbage, is a nutrient-rich vegetable that offers numerous health benefits. It is packed with vitamins C, K, and A, which support immune function, bone health, and skin integrity. The presence of antioxidants like sulforaphane helps reduce inflammation and may lower the risk of chronic diseases. Incorporating cabbage into your diet can improve digestion, enhance heart health, and contribute to overall well-being in everyday life.
